name: Ouu Khatta
ingredients: 1/2 tsp panch phutana (cumin, mustard, fennel, fenugreek, and nigella seeds)
instructions: 1. Peel the outer skin of the elephant apple, chop it into small pieces, and pressure cook with water, salt, and turmeric until soft.
2. Once cooked, lightly mash the pieces.
3. Heat mustard oil in a pan, add panch phutana and dried red chilies to temper.
4. Add the mashed elephant apple to the pan and stir for a few minutes.
5. Add jaggery and chili powder, stirring until the jaggery melts and the mixture thickens to a jam-like consistency.
6. Adjust salt to taste and serve warm or cold as a side dish.
description: Ouu Khatta is a quintessential Odia sweet and sour side dish often served during festivals and weddings. It highlights the unique flavor of the elephant apple, a seasonal fruit, balancing its tartness with the sweetness of jaggery and the earthiness of traditional spices.
